Generated Narrative: CodeSystem dosage-condition-code

Properties

This code system defines the following properties for its concepts

Name Code Type Description
type type code The type that goes in ConditionDetails.value for this code
details details string Documentation about what might go in the details for this code

Concepts

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/dosage-condition-code defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:

Code Display Definition type details
if-needed If Needed Whether this is needed. Note that this is different to PRN, because the entire course is if required, not on a per dose basis boolean N/A
tolerates Patient tolerates Medication Whether the patient tolerates a medication (e.g. SCT 1303423003) boolean Can nominate another medication that this depends on; if none is nominated, it's the medicine this dose is for
problem-abates Problem Abates Whether a symptom, problem of finding abates. It's not really important what type it is. This is considered equivalent to 'patient responds to medication'. The degree of abatement is not defined boolean Detail would be a problem, symptom or finding, if it's not just implied
problem-presents Problem Presents Whether a symptom, problem of finding presents. It's not really important what type it is. boolean Detail would be a problem, symptom or finding, if it's not just implied
medication-tolerated Medication Tolerated Medication Is Tolerated boolean Can nominate another medication that this depends on; if none is nominated, it's the medicine this dose is for
medication-funded Medication Funded Medication Is Funded / Approved boolean Can nominate another medication that this depends on; if none is nominated, it's the medicine this dose is for
medication-available Medication Available (Sufficient) medication Is Available (e.g. Supply issues) boolean Can nominate another medication that this depends on; if none is nominated, it's the medicine this dose is for
